requirements.statement: Each text link signalled only by colour, whose nature is not evident, has a colour with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 with the surrounding text.

citations.quote: chaque lien texte signalé uniquement par la couleur, et dont la nature n’est pas évidente, vérifie-t-il ces conditions ?
La couleur du lien a un rapport de contraste supérieur ou égal à 3:1 par rapport au texte environnant ;

routes.statement: The contrast ratio between the link's text colour and the surrounding text's colour is 3:1 or more, in each state presented with a different colour.

citations.quote: vérifier que le contraste entre la couleur de police du lien et la couleur de police du texte environnant est de 3:1, au moins ;
Cette vérification doit être faite pour les différents états du lien s’ils sont présentés au moyen d’une couleur différente

requirements.statement: Each such link has a visual indication on hover other than a change of colour.

citations.quote: Le lien dispose d’une indication visuelle au survol autre qu’un changement de couleur ;

routes.statement: Hovering the link changes something visible other than colour.

citations.quote: indication visuelle au survol autre qu’un changement de couleur

requirements.statement: Each such link has a visual indication on focus other than a change of colour.

citations.quote: Le lien dispose d’une indication visuelle au focus autre qu’un changement de couleur.

routes.statement: Focusing the link changes something visible other than colour.

citations.quote: indication visuelle au focus autre qu’un changement de couleur

rationale.text: The test applies to text links signalled only by colour whose nature is not evident, and asks three things of each: a colour contrast of 3:1 with the surrounding text, a non-colour indication on hover, and one on focus. They are separate requirements, since all three must hold. Which links are concerned is judgment in general: the glossary defines them as links that can be confused with normal text when signalled only by colour, and a marker may be an icon, an underline, a border or anything else in its open list. Hover and focus indications are judgment too, and need interaction. The candidate is none. The custom check looks for a plain text link in running text, styled like its parent in every inherited property but colour, with no decoration or nearby marker, whose colour contrasts below 3:1 with the parent's text. Its fault is evidence only. The test covers only links whose nature is not evident, and styling cannot settle that: the words around a link can make its nature evident. In « Suivez le lien Documentation pour commencer » (Codex's example), an unadorned link on Documentation matches every predicate of the check, yet the sentence itself says it is a link, so it may be outside the test's scope. The check leaves out text that reads as an address and some adjacent symbols, but it cannot read the meaning of the surrounding words, so it cannot prove that its witness is in scope. The link keeps its route and its scope and becomes evidence_only; the check never answers no_fault, so its whole scope supports no positive result. What would raise the entry: an independent way to establish that the link's nature is not evident (which needs judgment today), with the contrast fault kept separate from hover and focus evidence. axe's link-in-text-block is evidence only too: it compares a link with its enclosing block rather than the adjacent text, passes a link of the same colour as the text (allowSameColor), which the glossary counts as concerned, and treats a background contrast as enough; its faults do not establish that the link's nature is not evident. Applicability is judgment: whether a page holds a link concerned by the test is judgment. Needs lists state and keyboard, for the hover and focus requirements.

citations.entry: Lien dont la nature n’est pas évidente
citations.quote: Note : “signalés uniquement par la couleur” signifie que le lien n’est accompagné d’aucun marqueur visuel (icône, soulignement, bordure…). En conséquence, un lien de la même couleur que le texte environnant est concerné par ce critère.

citations.entry: Lien dont la nature n’est pas évidente
citations.quote: Lien qui peut être confondu avec un texte normal lorsqu’il est signalé uniquement par la couleur par certains types d’utilisateurs ne percevant pas ou mal les couleurs.
lien ne contenant aucun élément enfant de type :
s’il peut être confondu avec un texte normal lorsqu’il est signalé uniquement par la couleur
